title: [v0.92.2][WP-01][planning] Publish and open the CodeFriend Beta 1 execution wave
goal: Create and independently review all 69 core task issues in sequential sprint batches, reconcile every planning projection, and publish consolidated launch evidence. Retain #671 as a separate milestone sidecar.
required_outcome: All 69 core tasks have unique canonical issues and complete reviewed task contracts; all planning projections and authenticated readbacks agree.
acceptance_criteria: Every task owns one complete result with explicit paths, dependencies, success/failure acceptance and PVF. All 60 new issues are reviewed before and after creation; all nine existing issues receive final live review. No omissions or duplicates.
inputs: Operator authorization to create every sprint and review all issues before implementation; canonical wave/specifications; reviewed creation selections; #671 separately assigned as a sidecar.
target_files_surfaces: docs/milestones/v0.92.2/**; issue #864 native cards and bounded scope-reconciliation evidence.
validation_plan: python3 docs/milestones/v0.92.2/validate_planning.py --self-test; all eleven retained issue-launch validators; native six-card validate; relative-link and diff checks; independent live and exact-head review.
demo_proof_requirements: No demo; deterministic documentation and issue-inventory proof only.
non_goals: Implementation, writer pause/live activation, merge, release approval.
notes_risks: Creation selections are recorded in CREATION_SELECTIONS_v0.92.2.md. PUB-CSDLC feedback is handled during ordinary iterative revision. No product implementation is claimed.
